current_activity: 2nd Motorized Infantry Division moves east on Kobryń to secure the left flank of XIX Corps
notes: Event date: sources covering 1939-09-17, cited below. Kennedy, The German Campaign in Poland (1939) (R2256, HyperWar, Campaign-III), says that while the 10th Panzer and 20th Motorized Infantry Divisions were taking Brześć (the citadel was taken on 17 September), the 2nd Motorized Infantry Division was assigned to secure the corps left flank and moved eastward in the direction of Kobryń. The claim is dated 17 September, the day the citadel fell and the same phase as Map 10. The withdrawal to Brześć is C13739.
